use_when.text: Use Light on white or cream surfaces.
Use Dark on brand-green or photo backgrounds that need a plate.
Use White for one-colour placement on dark surfaces.
Use Logo/Symbol on its own for the app icon and favicon.

dont_use_when.text: Do not recolor the tile or monogram outside the four themes.
Do not stretch, rotate, outline or add effects.
Do not retype the wordmark or change its weights.
Do not put Light on dark or busy photos.
Do not go below 24 px. Use the symbol alone instead.

best_practice.text: Choose the theme first, then the size. Use Medium unless the space says otherwise.
Check the logo against the real background before you ship it.

variant_intent.intent: Use Light on white or cream surfaces.
Use Dark on brand-green or photo backgrounds that need a plate.
Use White for one-colour placement on dark surfaces.
Use Small where space is tight, such as a mobile header.
Use Medium unless the space says otherwise.
Use Large on hero areas and cover pages.

placement.text: Top Nav, left side, inside the home link, Theme Light, Size Medium.
Footer brand column, Theme Light, Size Medium, above the tagline.
Sidebar header when expanded, Theme Dark, Size Small, beside the collapse Icon Button.

a11y.text: Renders a <span> with role="img" and aria-label, defaulting to "Lemonade Found".
The mark and the visible wordmark are aria-hidden="true"; the SVG is also focusable="false".
Give the logo the alt text “Lemonade Found” when it is the only place the name appears. Mark it decorative when the name is written beside it.
Link the header logo to home and give it a visible focus ring.
Keep text contrast at 4.5:1 or higher. Switch to Dark or White on low-contrast backgrounds.
Leave space equal to the width of the L stem on every side.

gaps.detail: Logo composes no other component: it draws its own mark (Logo.tsx:42-47) rather than rendering Logo/Symbol, and no story pairs it with a sibling component.
